hello.text: The guide inclines their head. "Welcome. This small place is a demonstration — a working loop you can pull apart: rooms and exits, a conversation like this one, an item to carry, a save you can return to. When you're ready, the study lies east."

hint.text: "A key, on the desk in the study. Take it, and you'll have walked the whole engine — title to ending. After that, the rest is yours to build."

bye.text: The guide steps aside and gestures east, patient as furniture.
